summary: Provides core capabilities for Python project analysis, including workspace and project context management, configuration parsing, module loading, path manipulation, error handling, and snapshot diffing.
responsibilities: Initialize project and workspace contexts for Python analysis.
Discover workspace roots and parse configuration files.
Load, analyze, and manage Python modules and source files.
Define custom error types and analysis phases.
Convert and manipulate various path representations.
Create, validate, diff, and commit project snapshots and changes.
relationships: ProjectContext encapsulates project configuration and roots.
WorkspaceContext encapsulates workspace configuration and associated projects.
AnalysisError incorporates AnalysisPhase to represent Python analysis errors.
Project change analysis compares previous and current snapshots.
design_decisions: Modular organization across analysis, error handling, path utilities, project management, and snapshot domains.
Object-oriented abstractions for project and workspace contexts.
Dataclasses and structured models for metadata and change analysis.
